answers.core:
I feel this is essential for more granular control of the SyntaxHighlighter / CodeHighlighter, so it being locked behind an add-on would make it a must have for anyone working with them who wants more exact control.
Especially since this would be used for many types of text / code editors (Like trying to make a GDScript code editor in Godot), or simply displaying any dynamic code to the user outside of those software cases.

title: Allow for access of default syntax highlighting in '_get_line_syntax_highlighting' inside SyntaxHighlighter / CodeHighlighter
